texts.preamble: Surendra Rohra Alias Babu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2025 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:87018 Court No. - 73 Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 5291 of 2025 Applicant :- Surendra Rohra Alias Babu Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Diwakar Tiwari,Gyanendra Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J. 1.
texts.facts: 5. Questioning the summoning order, the applicant has been filed the present application.
texts.arguments: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that a complaint was lodged by the opposite party no. 2 on 09.05.2024 under Section 26(2)(I), 26(2)(III) read with Section 59(III), 63 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 which an allegation that in the premises of the applicant an inspection was conducted on 23.06.2023 at 6.00 PM wherein the product being Kesar-Supadi was found not as per the specifications and standards under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. 6. Learned counsel for the applicant has made various submissions, however, he confined his argument while submitting that the summoning order is stereotype passed by non-application of mind without even reciting the case of the complainant. He seeks to rely upon the judgment in the case of M/S. JM Laboratories vs State of Andhra Pradesh 2025 INSC 127. He further submits that the summoning order dated 03.07.2024 be [LEAKAGE_MASK] and the matter be remitted back to Court below to pass fresh orders. 7. Shri Indrajeet Singh Yadav, learned AGA submits that though the product in question was not as per the standards as required under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, however, according to him, the summoning order dated 03.07.2024 appears to have been passed on incorrect perspective. According to him, he submits that the summoning order dated 03.07.2024 be [LEAKAGE_MASK] and the matter be remitted back to Court below to pass fresh orders. 12. The Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of JM Laboratories (supra), para 9 whereof is quoted hereinunder.- We therefore find that in light of the view taken by us in criminal appeal arising out of SLP (Crl.) No. 2345 of 2024 titled "INOX Air Products Limited Now Known as INOX Air Products Private Limited and Another v. The State of Andhra Pradesh", and the legal position as has been laid down by this Court in a catena of judgments including in the cases of Pepsi Foods Ltd. and another Vs. Special Judicial Magistrate and others, Sunil Bharti Mittal Vs. Central Central Bureau of Investigation, Mehmood U Rehman Vs. Khazir Mohammad Tunda and others and Krishna Lal Chawla and others Vs. State of Uttar Pradesh and another, the present appeal deserves to be allowed." Surendra Rohra Alias Babu vs State Of U.P. And Another on 22 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147065477/ 3 13.
